title: TSDuck: Open-source toolkit for MPEG-TS analysis and manipulation
summary: TSDuck is an open-source, cross-platform toolkit for analyzing and manipulating MPEG Transport Streams, widely used in digital TV broadcasting, DVB/ATSC environments, and streaming applications with a plugin-based architecture.
problem_solved: Provides professional-grade tools for analyzing, debugging, monitoring, filtering, and modifying MPEG Transport Streams in broadcast and streaming environments.
why_valuable: Offers a comprehensive, extensible, and free solution that saves broadcast engineers and developers from building custom TS analysis tools from scratch.
